subject.title: fix(diagnostics): reclaim zombie embedded-run counters left idle by handle-mismatch clears

question: Should idle sessions with no queued work but stale active embedded-run activity be force-recovered through active-abort after stuckSessionAbortMs, or should this wait for a root-cause prevention/dispatch fix?
rationale: The source evidence supports the recovery gap, but choosing active-abort behavior for an idle/no-queue session is a session-state availability tradeoff that green tests cannot settle.

options.title: Refresh And Reconcile Recovery Policy
options.body: Resolve the conflict on current main, preserve merged progress-age recovery behavior, compare against adjacent dispatch-liveness work, and rerun focused diagnostics validation before merge.

options.title: Accept The Bounded Mitigation
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept force-clearing stale idle active-run bookkeeping after the abort threshold as the desired recovery tradeoff.

options.title: Pause For Root-Cause Prevention
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers require a live Slack reproduction or prevention fix for the handle leak before changing recovery behavior.
